event_data.context: Migrated from GitHub issue #1: https://github.com/jwilger/eventcore/issues/1. Originally Forgejo #248 and beads eventcore-012. The issue states a dependency on former #247 (performance benchmarking suite); verify the present benchmark evidence before designing snapshot frequency or storage APIs.
event_data.summary: Determine from benchmarks whether long-lived streams need snapshots, then add configurable snapshot persistence and reconstruction support if justified.
event_data.title: Add benchmark-driven snapshot support
